title: Box 17.XXX Testing criteria for Li–Fraumeni syndrome (adapted from the National Comprehensive Cancer Network; NCCN.org)
tablehtml:
Individual from family with known germline pathogenic/likely pathogenic TP53 variant

Individual meeting classic LFS criteria:

Individual diagnosed with sarcoma at < 45 years of age AND a first-degree relative diagnosed with cancer at < 45 years of age AND an additional first- or second-degree relative with cancer diagnosed at < 45 years of age or sarcoma at any age

Individual meeting Chompret criteria (see Box 9.02)

Personal or family history of paediatric hypodiploid acute lymphoblastic leukaemia

For individual with cancer with P/LP TP53 variant detected on tumour-only genomic testing, constitutional testing should be considered for:

 

Those meeting one or more of the above LFS testing criteria after re-evaluation of personal and family history
 

Those diagnosed with any cancer at age < 30 years

 

Those warranting constitutional evaluation per clinician discretion

LFS, for Li–Fraumeni syndrome; P/LP: pathogenic/likely pathogenic
